Robofil 100 V2 candidate policy record

Recorded candidate programs: prisma-recommended.iso and prisma-exterior-reversed.iso.

The operator-corrected lifecycle emits only G92 at program start. The program selects the
compensation side with G41 or G42, then activates the offset with G38 D0. Linear and
absolute-center circular interpolation use G1, G2, or G3. Program completion emits G40,
G39, and M02 in that order.

Compensation remains modal across clear G0 contour transitions and manual rethread pauses. If the
next contour has the same wire side, no offset commands are repeated. If its side changes,
the candidate emits the new G41 or G42 and G38 D0 for entry, without G40 or G39 between
contours. G40 and G39 occur only at program end. This direct side switch is supported by
manuals for adjacent Robofil generations, but not verified on this exact Robofil 100.

The rapid wire separation and M00 manual pause are operator-reported candidate behavior.
Their physical effect and the direct side switch require graphics simulation and a
supervised dry run on Cristian's Robofil 100.

This is an editable test candidate. It is not a claim of machine readiness.
